{{Quote|The Sepan peoples have been torn apart by civil war for generations. Each of the rival factions (the Ripoblus and the Dimoks) is guilty of committing atrocities against the other.|[[Imperial briefing officer]]|<ref name="TF" />}}
The '''Sepan''' were a [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]]<ref name="TFCCD:TOSG" /> of [[humanoid/Legends|humanoids]]<ref name="TF" /> native to the eponymous [[Sepan system/Legends|Sepan system]],<ref name="TFCCD:TOSG" /> a part of the [[Sepan sector/Legends|Sepan sector]]<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref> in [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]].<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>

The Sepan were divided between the peoples of [[Dimok/Legends|Dimok]] and [[Ripoblus/Legends|Ripoblus]],<ref name="TFCCD:TOSG" /> the two primary [[Planet/Legends|worlds]] of the [[Star system/Legends|system]].<ref name="CSWE-Dimok">{{CSWECite|I|189|Dimok}}</ref><ref name="CSWE-Ripoblus">{{CSWECite|III|101|Ripoblus}}</ref>

The [[Dimok (people)|Dimoks]] and the [[Ripoblus (people)|Ripoblus]] were involved in the [[Sepan Civil War]], a conflict which lasted intermittently for [[Standard century/Legends|centuries]].<ref name="HNN">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|49|jediwatch/13328_2.html|Sepan Civil War Escalates}}</ref><ref name="TF" /><ref name="Sacrifice">''[[Legacy of the Force: Sacrifice]]''</ref><ref name="TEGtW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref>
